section.heading: Refundable credit for coverage under a qualified health plan

paragraph.heading: Other terms and rules relating to premium assistance amounts

subparagraph.heading: Applicable second lowest cost silver plan
subparagraph.chapeau: The applicable second lowest cost silver plan with respect to any applicable taxpayer is the second lowest cost silver plan of the individual market in the rating area in which the taxpayer resides which—

subclause.chapeau: self-only coverage in the case of an applicable taxpayer—

item.content: whose tax for the taxable year is determined under section 1(c) 22 See References in Text note below. (relating to unmarried individuals other than surviving spouses and heads of households) and who is not allowed a deduction under section 151 for the taxable year with respect to a dependent, or

subparagraph.continuation: If a taxpayer files a joint return and no credit is allowed under this section with respect to 1 of the spouses by reason of subsection (e), the taxpayer shall be treated as described in clause (ii)(I) unless a deduction is allowed under section 151 for the taxable year with respect to a dependent other than either spouse and subsection (e) does not apply to the dependent.

section.sourceCredit: (Added and amended Pub. L. 111–148, title I, § 1401(a), title X, §§ 10105(a)–(c), 10108(h)(1), Mar. 23, 2010, 124 Stat. 213.)
